page_title: COM 1-3 ACM | Como v AC Milan 15/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Marco Guida is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+3' A pass by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jacobo Ramon (Como) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' 1 - 3 What a beautiful moment! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Jean Butez just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:3.
86' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers will be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
86' Substitution. Luka Modric walks off the pitch and Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) comes on as a substitute.
84' Nico Paz (Como) gets inside the box and tries to beat Mike Maignan with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
83' Marco Guida interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
82' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) misses a great chance after he found some space in the box! His glancing header goes over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
81' The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Now AC Milan have a corner.
78' Some neat passing and movement from Como as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
76' The game has come to an end for Alberto Moreno. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Roberto (Como).
72' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
70' Substitution. Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) replaces Youssouf Fofana.
70' Here is a change. Rafael Leao is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan).
68' The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
68' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mergim Vojvoda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como).
66' The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
62' Substitution. Christopher Nkunku makes way for Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
62' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Rodriguez (Como) replacing Martin Baturina.
60' It will be a substitution. Maxence Caqueret (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Da Cunha walks off.

59' Nico Paz (Como) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
59' Como have been awarded a corner kick.
55' 1 - 2 Goal! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
54' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
52' Good work from Como as they win a corner.

51' Nico Paz (Como) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Como.
49' Martin Baturina (Como) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
49' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
48' The linesman raises his flag. Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
46' Cesc Fabregas has made a change at the break. Diego Carlos (Como) has come on in place of Marc Oliver Kempf.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Marco Guida has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jean Butez to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45+1' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to AC Milan!
45' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for AC Milan as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
44' A clumsy foul by Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) and Marco Guida blows his whistle. The referee gives a penalty to AC Milan!
42' Como force their opponents to concede a corner.
41' Mike Maignan produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper.
37' The ball goes wide of the goal and out for a goal kick. It looks like Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is going to take it.
33' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
32' Nico Paz (Como) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Mike Maignan stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.

29' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
27' The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner.

27' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Corner kick. AC Milan will have an opportunity.
27' Como keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
24' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Como.

24' Nico Paz (Como) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Mike Maignan has it covered and makes a comfortable save. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
19' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jacobo Ramon (Como). AC Milan have a free kick.
17' Some patient build-up play from Como as they look to unlock the defence.
15' Some great controlled play and passing from AC Milan. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Martin Baturina (Como) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.

10' 1 - 0 Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) outjumps the defenders inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a header into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:0.
9' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
8' Nico Paz (Como) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
6' Como players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
3' AC Milan hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
2' It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Como will have the kick-off.
Marco Guida got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
